cento.definition:
n. A literary or a musical composition formed by selections
   from different authors disposed in a new order.
cento.translation: n. 抄袭拼凑而成的文艺作品(或乐曲), 拼凑物, 杂烩

centonism.definition:
n. The composition of a cento; the act or practice of
   composing a cento or centos.
centonism.translation: n. 摘录, 集句；组曲；杂烩 (cento的变形)

centos.translation: abbr. 社区企业操作系统（Community Enterprise Operating System）
